//: Zoho People attendance, switched off for now (ATTENDANCE in extension.js). To switch it back on: set ATTENDANCE to true, and put these back into package.json: the commands at the end of contributes.commands, the settings at the end of contributes.configuration.properties.

ajwain.zoho.region.markdownDescription: Your Zoho data centre: the one in the address you open Zoho People at. **Ajwain: Connect Zoho People** sets it.

ajwain.zoho.email.markdownDescription: Your email in Zoho People: the punches are recorded for this employee.

enumDescriptions: When you open VS Code (or come back to it) on a workday and aren't punched in yet, a pop-up asks whether to punch in. Once a day, from 3 hours before the in time.
Punch in at `#ajwain.attendance.in#`. If VS Code starts later, at the real time.
Only when you punch in yourself.
ajwain.attendance.punchIn.markdownDescription: How you're punched in to Zoho People on `#ajwain.attendance.days#`.

enumDescriptions: Punch out at `#ajwain.attendance.out#`, timed then even if VS Code notices later that evening.
From `#ajwain.attendance.out#`, a pop-up asks whether to punch out. Once a day.
Only when you punch out yourself.
ajwain.attendance.punchOut.markdownDescription: How you're punched out of Zoho People.

ajwain.attendance.days.markdownDescription: The days Ajwain punches you in automatically.
